translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: E Guyau ikaraiwogi taitala tovitoubobuta guma Yuda ila mapilana Beteli e iviloubusi tutala Yeroboam bogwa eitotu okabogwabu lula paila bigabu lula.

Makawala Guyau la karaiwaga, tovitoubobuta matauna ikawau kabogwabu lula makwaina kawala. “O kabogwabu lula, kabogwabu lula, baisa makawala avaka Guyau eilivala. Ka taitala gwadi igau bikaloubusi metoya odalela Debida e magudina bidokaisi yagala Yosaia. Matauna bikatumati odabam goli tolula matausina eiuwotetilasi okabogwabu lula makwaisina paila tokolu matausina goli bigibugabusi lula odabam, e matauna bigibuki lula tomota totuwanesi odabam.”

E matauna tovitoubobuta isetuwoli wala la bigatona kawala, “Ka makwaina kabogwabu lula bidadaimi e tubwagela odabala makwaina bikaligiaki wala. E wa tuta matutona yokomi bukunikolaisi ulo biga avaka yeigu lalivali leima metoya baisa Guyau eililivala metoya baisa yeigu.”
Avai tuta guyau Yeroboam ilagi baisa, e iyosali yamala ivakasi matauna e ikaraiwaga kawala, “Kuyokavataisi tau matauna!” E tuta matutona wala guyau yamala itola e gala wala igagabila bikatupwi.
E kwaitala wala momwa kabogwabu lula idadaimi e tubwagela ikaligeyaisi wala watanawa makawala avaka tovitoubobuta eivitobuboti oyagala Guyau.

E guyau Yeroboam iluki tovitoubobuta kawala, “Mwa akoma lopom kunigada baisa Guyau m Yaubada paila yeigu, kunigadi matauna bivagi yamagu bimalolisa!” Mapaila tovitoubobuta inigada baisa Guyau, e guyau Yeroboam yamala imalolisa.
Oluvi guyau iluki tovitoubobuta, kawala, “Mwa kuma bitala ogu bwala takam, e yeigu bamapwaim avaka lokuvagi.”
E tovitoubobuta ivitakauloki kawala, “Ilagoli kidamwa bukusakaigu mabila m veiguwa, yeigu gala bawokaiam bakam kaina bamom deli yoku.
Guyau leikaraiwogaigu gala bakam avaka kaina bamom, e gala bavayumali bakwaigu bala ogu valu wa keda makadana lama.”
Mapaila matauna gala ivayumali bakwaila keda makadana leima, mitaga ilouya keda ituwoli.
Taitala tovitoubobuta tomoya mapilana Beteli

Wa tuta matutona taitala tovitoubobuta tomoya isisu mapilana Beteli. Litula tauwau imakaiasi matauna e ilukwaisi avaka tovitoubobuta matauna tolela Yuda bogwa leivagi wa yam makwaina ovalu Beteli deli avaka leiluki guyau Yeroboam.
E matauna tovitoubobuta tomoya ikatupoi matausina kawala, “Ka! Avai tuta leisilavi e ammakadana eisum?” Matausina ivitulokaisi ammakadana eisuki
e iluki bikatubiasaisi la ase. Matausina ikatubiasaisi la ase e ikatuwakeda

ibokuli tovitoubobuta matauna tolela Yuda, e ila ibani matauna eisisu osikowala kaitala yawa. Matauna ikatupoi kawala, “Ki, yoku tovitoubobuta tolem Yuda ke?” Tau matauna ivitakauloki kawala, “E mayeigula.”
Iluki matauna kawala, “Kuma bitala ogu bwala takam.”

Mitaga tovitoubobuta matauna tolela Yuda ivitakauloki kawala, “Ka, gala bitala om bwala kaina bakabwaili avaka m kwamaiaba. Deli gala avaka bakoma kaina bamom avai vavagi metoya baisa yoku tuta baisa,
paila uula Guyau bogwa eikaraiwogaigu gala kwaitala vavagi bakoma kaina bamom, deli gala basuyumali bakwaigu wa keda makadana lama.”

Oluvi matauna tovitoubobuta tomoya tolela Beteli iluki matauna kawala, “Yeigu madeilila wala, yeigu taitala tovitoubobuta makawala yoku, e Guyau ikaraiwogi taitala la anelosi ima ilukwaigu balauwaim ogu bwala e bayomitali kam mitakwai.” Mitaga matauna tovitoubobuta tomoya isisasopa wala.
Mapaila tovitoubobuta matauna tolela Yuda iwokaia matauna tovitoubobuta tomoya ilosi ola bwala ikamsi.
Avai tuta eisilaisi baisa, Guyau iviyelu nanola tovitoubobuta tomoya avaka bilivala,
e matauna ikabau wala baisa matauna tovitoubobuta tolela Yuda kawala, “Mwa, Guyau ikaibiga bogwa lokukoulovi matauna, e gala kuvagi avaka la karaiwaga.
Kaimapula yoku kukwaimilavau kula kukwam ambaisa matauna leikaraiwogaim gala bukukwam. Mauula yoku bikatumataim, e wowom gala bibakwaisi okami laka deli dalem.”
Avai tuta bogwa leivenokusi kamkwam, e matauna tovitoubobuta tomoya ikatubiasi minana ase paila tovitoubobuta matauna tolela Yuda,
e matauna isila ikatuwakeda. E otapwala keda ibodi natana laiyoni e ikamati matauna. Matauna wowola ikanubodi wala keda, e ase minana deli laiyoni itotusi opapala matauna.
Mimilisi tauwau leimaisi igisaisi wowola wa keda, deli laiyoni itotu opapala matauna. Matausina ilosi Beteli e ikamitulaisi avaka bogwa leigisaisi.

Avai tuta matauna tovitoubobuta tomoya ilagi bulogala, ikaibiga kawala, “Tovitoubobuta matauna eikoulovi Guyau la karaiwaga! Mapaila Guyau eiwitali laiyoni biyokavati matauna e bikatumati, makawala avaka Guyau eilivala bileiki makawala.”
Oluvi matauna iluki litula kawala, “Kukwatubiasaisi ulo ase.” Matausina ivagaisi makawala.
Matauna isila isakaula e ila ibani tovitoubobuta wowola eiyomalaula opapala keda. Laiyoni gala ikoma wowola matauna kaina iyokavati ase minana.
E matauna tovitoubobuta tomoya ilupi tomata minana isaila ola ase, e ilau Beteli ivilam matauna e ibaku.
Matauna ilau okasi laka deli dalela e ibaku matauna, e matauna deli litula ivilamwaisi e ikavinavinasi kawasi, “O bodamasʹe e, bodamasʹe e.”
Avai tuta bogwa leibakwaisi tovitoubobuta matauna iluki litula kawala, “Ka, avai tuta bakaliga bukubakwaigusi okada lakasi wala katitaikinela matauna.
Biga mabigasina eilivali metoya Guyau ola karaiwaga paila kabogwabu lula makwaina olopola Beteli deli goli komwaidona makatuposina si kabotapwaroru oviluwela Sameria bikaloubusi makawala.
Yeroboam la mitugaga vakaigaga

E Yeroboam guyoula Isireli matauna gala wala ininavila metoya ola mitugaga, mitaga isetuwoli wala ininagi tolula matausina dala ituwoli paila biwotetilasi okabolula makwaisina matauna leikaliaii. E matauna ikiwoti availa wala magila bivigaki makawala tolula.
E mitugaga makwaina leivagi leiyomituli kala kodadaimi la guyau e mokwitatoula wala ikitumou kala pikowau la guyau.
